description: This file defines the interface for charger driver APIs in the Zephyr project, including enums, structs, and function prototypes for managing charger properties, states, and notifications.

methods.name: charger_get_prop
methods.description: Fetch a battery charger property using device pointer, property identifier, and value pointer.

methods.name: charger_set_prop
methods.description: Set a battery charger property using device pointer, property identifier, and value pointer.

methods.name: charger_charge_enable
methods.description: Enable or disable a charging cycle on the device.
